reply_text:
I found no AI predictions with a date or timeframe that Demis Hassabis said or wrote in 2013. I ran the three required searches exactly as written and 8 more on what he did that year, 11 of the 12 allowed. I opened no pages, because none of the results looked like his own words from 2013, so nothing below is quoted.

- **What came up:** almost everything was about his recent timelines for when AGI arrives (2025–2026), plus older interviews from 2014–2024.
- **What 2013 did hold:** DeepMind's Atari game-playing system (DQN), presented at the NIPS deep learning workshop in December 2013, and Google's approach to buy the company that year. Search results mention these only as background in later articles.
- **Later retellings, which don't count:** the Walter Isaacson material in Time describes a 2013 argument at Elon Musk's birthday party. It reports Musk's warnings and a Hassabis remark about Mars, not a dated prediction quoted from Hassabis at the time. A podcast transcript also refers to a June 2013 conversation.
- **Wrong year:** an IET public lecture on YouTube showed "4015 days ago" in the results, which points to about 2015. I didn't open it to confirm the date.

DeepMind kept a low profile before the Google deal, so few public statements from Hassabis in 2013 seem to exist. This could be a gap in searchable sources rather than proof he made no predictions. A sources-checker might want to look at UK press interviews from late 2013 or video of any talks he gave that year.
